label: Meena: an amount the two models write differently
description: Synthetic demo. Play Meena, born 1991, who can say what she took with the loan and what she paid. A prepared clip, chosen because Prisma v3.0 and Prisma v2.5 are known to write her spoken amount differently on phone-line TTS audio: it shows the bot asking again and reading back. One chosen clip, not a rate.
readings_note: Chosen clip: the two models are known to write this spoken amount differently on phone-line TTS audio. One example, not a rate.
